name: spec-driven-development
description: Spec-driven development workflow: steering documents, feature specs (requirements/design/tasks/review-log), verification, and agent-based implementation on a generator/arbiter split — the main agent arbitrates while persistent subagent sessions author, implement (parallel groups by file-disjointness), test, and review to 0 issues. Tests are specified as spec-anchored cases in design.md and written by a dedicated agent kept blind to the implementation, so the suite survives refactoring instead of rotting. Enforces 'no spec, no code' discipline, with a project backlog for deferred discoveries and an advisor gate that settles clear-cut decisions instead of interrupting the user.
